task.title: Register the aggregation job and wire real five-minute cron
task.input: job-leases, analytics-aggregate and shared M3 HTTP protections
task.output: job-foundation and analytics-aggregate-runtime; a fixed registry, POST /api/admin/cron/operations and real cron
task.accept: 1) composition registers only the implemented analytics-aggregate; deploy/cron.nbshiyan calls POST /api/admin/cron/operations every five minutes. Validate fixed keys/Bearer credentials in constant time; reject unknown keys/missing credentials and permit no arbitrary scripts. 2) Real scheduling executes after restart and commits JobState/watermark, with batch at most 500, a 55s deadline and no old-generation overwrite. Stopped cron/failure preserves the last successful watermark and exposes safe NEVER/FAILED/stale-value state; route existence/manual invocation does not justify claiming just updated (E-81, E-84). 3) After real-browser consent, complete two same-day page visits in the same browser and refresh/retry the same eventId. After the actual job UV stays 1, genuine new visits increase PV and duplicate events do not increase counts (E-44). Dashboard GET does not trigger jobs; M4 registers notification/mail jobs, without future-service imports or empty implementations.
